readme: Comm-link greetings from ordinary fleets of the faction whose council you sit on, one per council tier (seat, tier 1, tier 2). Tokens: {title} {lastName} {fullName} {sirOrMadam}. Factions not listed use default. Other mods can add a faction under factions.
default: The captain gives you a nod across the comm. "{title} {lastName}. Good to see a friendly transponder out here. Shout if you need anything."
The captain straightens up. "{title} {lastName}, {sirOrMadam}. You have this fleet's respect, for whatever that's worth out here. Anything you need?"
The captain comes to attention, and the bridge crew follows. "{title} {lastName}. An honour, {sirOrMadam}. We're at your disposal."

hegemony: The captain snaps a salute that even the comm lag can't spoil. "{title} {lastName}. Hegemony patrol, holding station. COMSEC has you logged as friendly."
"{title} {lastName}, {sirOrMadam}." The captain's salute is textbook. "This fleet is at your disposal. Nobody in this system will trouble you while we're here."
Behind the captain, the whole bridge crew comes to attention. "{title} {lastName}. An honour, {sirOrMadam}. Give the word and the fleet moves."
sindrian_diktat: "{title} {lastName}. Glory to the Diktat." The officer's salute is precise to the point of anxiety. "Your presence has been noted and approved."
The officer goes rigid. "{title} {lastName}! Glory to the Diktat. Your orders, {sirOrMadam}? We will carry them out exactly."
The officer turns pale, then very straight. "{title} {lastName}. The Supreme Executor's own hand in this sector. We are honoured, and we are listening."
persean: "{title} {lastName}, welcome." The captain raises a glass just out of frame. "The League remembers its friends. Fair travels."
"{title} {lastName}. The houses speak well of you, which is rare enough to be worth mentioning. Can this fleet be of service?"
The captain inclines their head with careful, old-fashioned formality. "{title} {lastName}. Kazeron sends its regards, I'm sure. Mine come with a fleet attached."
tritachyon: "{title} {lastName}." The captain's smile is polished and brief. "Your transponder came up green on our partner registry. Pleasure doing business."
"{title} {lastName}. I've been told to extend you every courtesy, and the board doesn't tell me twice. What can we do for you?"
The captain's smile is fixed and very expensive. "{title} {lastName}. Anything you need. Really, anything. Perhaps mention us in your next quarterly review."
luddic_church: "Ludd keep you, {title} {lastName}." The captain makes the sign of the flame. "It gladdens us to see a faithful hand at the helm."
The captain bows their head. "{title} {lastName}. The congregation of this fleet would be grateful for your blessing, and for your orders."
A hush falls over the bridge as the captain kneels before the comm. "{title} {lastName}. Ludd's light upon you. Command us, and we will follow."
luddic_path: "{title} {lastName}." The captain's stare doesn't waver. "The Path is long. Walk it well, and the faithful will walk it with you."
"{title} {lastName}. The faithful know your name. Tell us who has strayed, and we will see to them."
The captain's eyes shine with a frightening joy. "{title} {lastName}! Ludd's fire walks with you. Speak, and the Path will burn whatever you name."
pirates: "Well, if it isn't {title} {lastName}." The captain waves off someone off-screen. "Relax, nobody here is dumb enough to shake down one of ours."
The captain grins, showing too many metal teeth. "{title} {lastName}! Word gets around. You want a cut of something, you just say so, boss."
The pirate on the screen suddenly remembers how to sit up straight. "{title} {lastName}. We, uh, didn't know it was you. Whatever you need, it's yours. No charge."
